bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test -d "$repo/.git" || test -f "$repo/.git"
echo "GAYBBS_LINK_PREFLIGHT"
echo "SOURCE_HEAD=$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "SOURCE_BRANCH=$(git -C "$repo" branch --show-current)"
echo "SOURCE_DIRTY=$(test -z "$(git -C "$repo" status --porcelain)" && echo no || echo yes)"
echo "SOURCE_ORIGIN=$(git -C "$repo" remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#(https?://)[^/@]+@#\\1#')"
echo "BOT_CONTAINER=$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Status}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
echo "BOT_IMAGE_ID=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
echo "DOCKER_COMPOSE=$(test -f "$repo/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" && echo present || echo absent)"
echo "USERBOT_SERVICE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
echo "GAYBBS_LINK_PREFLIGHT_END"
